title.narrative: Enabling durable solutions to internal displacement in Mozambique

description.narrative: The Joint Programme (JP) supports the Government of Mozambique in advancing implementation of the Action Plan for the Management of Internal Displacement (PEGDIAP), aiming to place prioritized internally displaced persons (IDPs) on pathways to durable solutions through a comprehensive and government-owned approach. The JP combines institutional strengthening, development of standardized tools, community engagement and policy advice, data systems strengthening and implementation of location-level solutions within a single integrated Durable Solutions Model. The programme supports both the strengthening of national systems required to manage durable solutions and the delivery of targeted interventions to demonstrate measurable progress in selected locations. The programme is structured around five complementary outcomes. The first three outcomes focus on strengthening the enabling environment through (i) Data for solutions, (ii) Inclusive community engagement, and (iii) Policy advice and institutional support for Government stakeholders, laying the foundations for the initiative. Building on these foundations, Outcomes 4 and 5 support the operationalization of durable solutions through area-based planning, implementation, and investment in solutions interventions. Moreover, other initiatives of the joint program include development of standardized data and progress measurement tools, strengthening displacement data systems, government capacity building, participatory consultations with displacement-affected communities, and integration of durable solutions into territorial planning and development processes. These components operate alongside implementation of area-based solutions addressing housing and settlements, access to civil documentation and justice, and strengthening of local service delivery systems.
